newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul gold volume shrinks on firmer prices.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul gold volume shrinks on firmer prices.

text.p: Istanbul gold exchange volume shrank to 515 kilos on Monday from Friday's 1,045 kilos as higher prices shrank demand, dealers said.
Gold closed firmer at $363.20 an ounce and 1,434,700 lira per gram, compared to $362.00 and 1,424,700 lira following higher levels in European markets.
The Turkish currency eased to 122,900 lira to the dollar from 122,410 at Friday's close fuelling gold prices in lira terms.
Of the day's trade, 325 kilos was done in the morning session and 70.9 percent was in dollar terms.
